title: ReleaseManifest
description: Per-package release metadata dispatched on tag v* from lic, lis, lip, lit, lidb, lig, li-math.

package.description: Ecosystem package id (lic, lis, lip, lit, lidb, lig, li-math).

git_sha.description: Full or short commit SHA at publish time.

published_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the release was published.

bench_required.description: When true, benchmarks repo should refresh CSV ingest for this package; never implies fabricated bench rows.

path.description: Repo-relative path under benchmarks (incoming dir or dispatch artifact).
